details.eligibility: Graduation in any discipline from a recognised university (as per the SBI PO notification on sbi.bank.in/web/careers).
details.pattern: Prelims: 100 questions, 60 minutes. Mains: 170 objective questions, 200 marks, 3 hours + descriptive English. Then Psychometric Test, Group Exercise & Interview. Note: from the 2025 cycle the Prelims sections changed to English 40 / Quant 30 / Reasoning 30 (earlier 30/35/35) and Mains to 170 questions — verify against the current advertisement.
details.syllabus: Quantitative Aptitude, Reasoning Ability, English Language, General/Banking Awareness, Data Analysis & Interpretation, Descriptive English (email, report/precis, situation analysis).
